entities.name: Foulmere
entities.description: Swamp on the delta of the Kron Lu River in Dominaria, once a lush marsh, ruined by a duel.

entities.name: Eub Hlut
entities.description: Tiny 8-inch tall gnome people of Foulmere.

entities.name: Peter Langwynd
entities.description: Naturalist and former professor who lived as a hermit in Foulmere and survived the disaster.

entities.name: Vram
entities.description: Planeswalker who dueled another planeswalker in Foulmere and was cast from the plane.

events.summary: Vram and Mao visit Peter, who is forced to give them a tour of Big Bog.
events.quote: Peter was forced to take them on a tour

events.summary: Vram tames the Big Bog Frog and uses it in a duel with another planeswalker.
events.quote: Vram tamed the beast and used it in a duel with another unnamed planeswalker.

events.summary: The duel overextends the land, draining Foulmere of mana; almost all life dies and both planeswalkers are cast from the plane.
events.quote: Vram and the other planeswalker had been cast away from the plane entirely

relations.quote: the planeswalker Vram and her daughter Mao
